name: Default
shortDescription: Shotcut non-linear video editor streamed to the browser behind a password, with settings, projects and exports kept on a persistent volume.

alerts.message: Sign in with the CUSTOM_USER and PASSWORD values from the environment. This basic auth is the only protection, and anyone who signs in gets passwordless sudo inside the container. Save projects under /config so they persist.
HTTPS is required; the browser desktop does not work over plain HTTP.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
